onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/category.schema.json, set oc_physics_mode to {{oc_physics_mode}}]
Set the character controller physics mode to {{oc_physics_mode}}. Kinematic = direct position delta; Force-Based = physics-simulated with momentum (useForceAsInputs in MovementAbility).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/category.schema.json, set oc_camera_style to {{oc_camera_style}}]
Set the camera style to {{oc_camera_style}} (adjusts targetDistance and fieldOfView in ThirdPersonCamera).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/category.schema.json, set ot_move_speed to {{ot_move_speed}}]
Set moveSpeed to {{ot_move_speed}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/category.schema.json, set ot_jump_impulse to {{ot_jump_impulse}}]
Set jumpImpulse to {{ot_jump_impulse}} in JumpAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/category.schema.json, set ot_gravity to {{ot_gravity}}]
Set gravity to Vec3(0, -{{ot_gravity}}, 0) in CharacterForceControllerBase.

action.template: Open the Movement module and show me all tunable properties.
Open the Abilities module and show me jump and dash properties.
Open the Camera module and show me all camera tunable properties.
